name: VisBug
summary: Open-source in-page design toolbar that lets you move, resize, restyle and measure live elements, and inspect spacing, alignment and accessibility properties like a design tool.
goodFor: Editing live elements in place — move, resize, restyle and measure them.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: css inspector visual design toolbar open source measure restyle
